pagesChanged.name: workflow
pagesChanged.change: Four server-backed business views: my_approvals (我的待办, default), my_requests (我发起的), my_decided (我审批的), my_cc (抄送我的), plus templates (模板设置). Removed the default and visible all view.

pagesChanged.name: workflow-case-detail
pagesChanged.change: Applicant/approver display names, explicit decision_context and admin override reason, requester withdrawal, failed-effect retry by effect_id, partial timeline state.

routeChanges: KEEP backend GET /v1/cases; add explicit view whitelist my_approvals|my_requests|my_decided|my_cc and return 422 data.reason=INVALID_CASE_VIEW for anything else.
KEEP backend POST /v1/cases, POST /v1/cases/{id}/submit and POST /v1/cases/{id}/withdraw; route through WorkflowCommandService -> CommandRunner with required Idempotency-Key and audit.
KEEP backend POST /v1/cases/{caseId}/decisions; route through WorkflowCommandService -> CommandRunner while preserving DecisionService assignment/delegation/admin-override rules.
KEEP backend POST /v1/effects/{id}/retry; route through WorkflowCommandService -> CommandRunner and retain EffectExecutor retry/idempotency semantics.
KEEP backend GET/POST /v1/workflow/templates; POST now requires Idempotency-Key and records audit.
REMOVE frontend legacy /cases and /cases/:id route registrations from frontend/src/router/index.ts (out of this agent file domain; no redirect).
DELETE frontend/src/views/CaseCenterView.vue and frontend/src/views/CaseDetailView.vue (out of this agent file domain; no redirect).
FIX frontend/src/views/DashboardView.vue link from /cases to /workflow (out of this agent file domain).
notes: Tests are written but NOT RUN: backend/tests/Feature/Workflow/CaseProjectionNamesTest.php, backend/tests/Feature/Workflow/DecisionAssignmentNegativesTest.php, frontend/tests/unit/WorkflowCenter.spec.ts, frontend/tests/unit/WorkflowTemplatePanel.spec.ts, frontend/tests/unit/WorkflowEffectRetry.spec.ts. No PHPUnit, Vitest, vue-tsc, Playwright or full repository gate was run.
Strict file domain: frontend/src/modules/platform/api/index.ts was NOT modified. The final views/actions consume the workflow-local adapter frontend/src/modules/platform/workflow/api.ts.

Strict file domain: routes/api.php, docs/openapi/openapi.yaml, docs/generated/** and frontend/src/router/** were NOT modified. OpenAPI must be updated by the lead for the new required CaseSummary fields requester_display_name/current_assignee_display_name/decided_by_display_name, decision_context, CaseEffect failure_summary/failed_at, timeline display-name/admin fields, the my_cc view, IdempotencyKeyRequired on POST /v1/effects/{id}/retry, minLength 10 for retry reason and the documented 202 response.

Strict file domain: backend/app/Modules/IAM/** was NOT modified. CaseQueryService depends on App\Modules\IAM\Contracts\UserAudienceDirectory::displayName(); IAM already binds the production EloquentUserAudienceDirectory and tests inject a fake.

No new migration was required: the existing cases, workflow_tasks, decisions, effects, case_events, case_members and workflow_templates schema already stores every fact used. CC recipients reuse case_members role=OBSERVER.

No approval assignee or effect success is synthesized. Direct assignment, delegation and admin-override remain server-authoritative; FAILED stays FAILED until a successful retry and an APPLIED retry is an attempts-preserving no-op.

Potential test-impact for the lead: workflow POST /v1/cases, /submit, /withdraw, /decisions, /effects/{id}/retry and /workflow/templates now require an Idempotency-Key; older callers that omitted it will receive 422 data.reason=IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED. Tests already sending headers remain compatible.

Potential test-impact for the lead: frontend/src/views/CaseCenterView.vue still calls the legacy case API barrel and /cases routes. It must be removed rather than kept as a hidden debug entry, as required by the plan.
